nodes.label: Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp. - Case Detail UI Screenshot
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a legal case management detail view for 'Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.' under Business/Contract category. The case is in 'In review' status. The view shows a structured case summary with fields: Core Issue (ERP system vendor NovaSoft Systems LLC delivered defective software 15 days late with 12 unresolved critical bugs, 5 months past deadline; total documented damages exceed $400,000 USD including $240k canceled orders, $80k client SLA penalties, $108k advance at risk), Client Priority (contract rescission, recovery of $108k advance payment, compensation for direct losses of $326k, and enforcement options), Live Deadlines (formal breach notice sent with a highlighted date, no statute of limitations risk noted, but vendor dissolution risk exists), Key Leverage (performance bond issued by Sureste Bonding Co., contract includes late-delivery penalty clause 0.5% per week totaling -$18,000 for 20 weeks delay; meeting minutes support scope approval; 47 documented incident reports with vendor responses), Vendor Response (counterparty has offered 20% discount on remaining balance in exchange for releasing the performance bond, rejected by client), Vendor Counterclaim Risk (NovaSoft may allege scope changes; client holds meeting minutes confirming changes were approved within original scope). Also shows a Timeline section with a Demo client created event on 6/4/2026 and an Add input for consultation notes. Interface includes action buttons: Edit, Client answers, Download HTML, Delete.
ui_elements: status bar with stages: Invited, New, In review, Consult scheduled, Conflict hold, Engaged, Declined, Closed
action buttons: Edit, Client answers, Download HTML, Delete
nodes.purpose: Display detailed case information for a legal/contract dispute within a case management platform, enabling attorneys or case managers to review key facts, leverage points, deadlines, and timeline.
